name: calais-order-execution
description: Low-latency C++ engine for Calais order execution
$comment: NOT YET USED. The foundation layer builds with no package manager at all --
GoogleTest and the nlohmann single header are fetched by cmake/CalaisDependencies.cmake.
This manifest is the plan for the next phase, when the transport and exchange
layers land. Install vcpkg and configure with
and CalaisDependencies.cmake will find these via find_package before falling

dependencies.name: boost-asio
dependencies.$why: event loop for cold-path coroutines (auth, reconnect, reconcile)

dependencies.name: boost-beast
dependencies.$why: WebSocket + HTTP client; correctness first, replaceable behind ITransport once measured

dependencies.name: openssl
dependencies.$why: TLS for wss://, and HMAC-SHA256 request signing

dependencies.name: cppzmq
dependencies.$why: control plane only -- the hot path uses core/shm_ring.h

dependencies.name: nlohmann-json
dependencies.$why: control-plane JSON; never on the hot path

dependencies.name: simdjson
dependencies.$why: on-demand parsing for exchange feeds, once profiling justifies it

dependencies.name: libpqxx
dependencies.$why: persistence, on a dedicated writer thread behind an SpscRing

dependencies.name: prometheus-cpp
dependencies.$why: metrics backend, wrapped behind a project MetricsClient

dependencies.name: quill
dependencies.$why: low-latency logging; spdlog is too heavy for the hot path
